items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...or for that matter sax players who try to play like Coltrane. ... 'cause Coltrane came up in that school...

ctx.x: there with Fletcher Henderson, Jay McShann, Billy Eckstein, Cab Calloway. He's got all that footage underneath him. You know that kind of background. So Dizzy knows where it's at. A lot of these kids will try to start where Dizzy's at now and they don't know where it's at.
They get a few cliches under their fingers, but they really don't know what he's doing... or for that matter sax players who try to play like Coltrane.

Impossible, see 'cause Coltrane came up in that school, you know, good foundation, working with those bands, different bands, different style bands, and they try to pick up right where Coltrane is now before he died, or the same way with the drummers, try to play like Max or Roy Haynes or Elvin or Buddy, and you just can't you know, it's impossible to be made a doctor over night. There's no way in the world that I've said it over and over, that you can skip grade school and go to high school. See, you've got to…
